pr.title: Phase-scope the overseer lifecycle instead of full pipeline
pr.description:
Make the overseer container phase-scoped: spawn at phase start, tear down
at phase completion. Saves resources during idle periods between phases and
HITL review windows. Each phase gets a fresh overseer instance.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: Updated test_overseer_spawn.py and test_pipeline_failure_path.py
- Manual: Run a multi-phase pipeline with overseer_enabled=True and verify overseer container is created/destroyed at phase boundaries (check `docker ps` between phases)
